title: Inside a catalytic converter
caption: A honeycomb coated with platinum, palladium and rhodium converts the three main pollutants in car exhaust: carbon monoxide and unburned hydrocarbons are oxidised, and nitrogen oxides are reduced to nitrogen.
alt: A flow from exhaust gases through the catalyst to cleaner gases, with the three reactions.
description: Hydrocarbons + O₂ → CO₂ + H₂O, for example C₈H₁₈.
